definitions.explanation: the company or location where one works

examples.japanese: {勤務先|きんむさき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your workplace address.

examples.japanese: {勤務先|きんむさき}は{駅|えき}から{近|ちか}いですか。
examples.english: Is your workplace close to the station?

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{勤務先|きんむさき}の{電話番号|でんわばんごう}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in your workplace phone number on the form.

notes:
FORMATION:
{勤務|きんむ} (work, duty) + {先|さき} (place, destination) → place of work

RELATED WORDS:
- {職場|しょくば} (workplace - more common in casual speech)
- {会社|かいしゃ} (company)
- {勤|つと}め{先|さき} (place of employment - similar)
- {勤務|きんむ} (work, duty)

USAGE:
{勤務先|きんむさき} is commonly used on official forms and documents. In casual conversation, {職場|しょくば} or simply {会社|かいしゃ} is more common. {勤|つと}め{先|さき} has a similar meaning and is also used on forms.

FORM FIELDS:
- {勤務先|きんむさき}{名|めい} (employer name)
- {勤務先|きんむさき}{住所|じゅうしょ} (work address)
- {勤務先|きんむさき}{電話番号|でんわばんごう} (work phone number)
